notes.title: To The Sea : Courier 1.0.0 Released
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the launch of the long-anticipated update for To The Sea: Courier!
What was once a glimpse of our vision in the demo edition has now transformed into a complete and immersive gaming experience, and it's ready for you to explore!

[h3]Dive into 10 New Playable Levels![/h3]

Venture into deeper waters with 10 brand new levels, each meticulously designed to challenge and delight players. Each level is a testament to our commitment to quality, gameplay mechanics, and narrative depth. As you progress, the story unfolds, revealing mysteries and challenges that will test your skills and wit.

[h3]The Tale Unfolds[/h3]

As players leap, slide, and solve their way through the game, they will also unravel an intricate story woven with surprises and poignant moments. Within the world of Dream Vision, the platforming challenges aren't just obstacles – they're narrative threads waiting to be unraveled. Every puzzle solved is a page turned, every leap is a twist in the tale, and every slide might just slide you closer to uncovering truths about this scattering world. Engage with unique characters, uncover hidden lore, and see how every action, every choice, shapes the direction of your journey.

[h3]Gratitude from the Depths[/h3]

Our journey to bring the game to you has been as thrilling as the waves of the vast ocean. It's been a voyage filled with challenges, late-night brainstorming sessions, and endless playtesting. But every moment was worth it, especially when we think of our incredible community.

Your unwavering support, feedback, and passion have been our guiding star. The love and commitment from our supporters have pushed us to refine and re-imagine our game, ensuring that what we deliver is nothing short of perfection. We owe the success and realization of this project to each and every one of you.

[h3]Set Sail![/h3]

Ready to set sail and immerse yourself in the story! Whether you're a returning player from the demo days or a new adventurer, we promise an experience that's both engaging and memorable.

Dive in, challenge the puzzles, uncover the mysteries, and most importantly, enjoy the journey!

Thank you,

Studio FANACCI & NyaaCat Development Team
